delay_feasibility_definition: actual_feasible if delay_minutes <= 15 (clinical grace / SLA); severe_delay if delay > 15

overlap_definition.direct_overlap: physical overlap: previous visit still running when next scheduled_start is due, or earliest_arrival exceeds previous scheduled_end
overlap_definition.cascading_delay: late start of a later visit caused by previous actual duration + travel, without requiring simultaneous occupancy at scheduled_start
